research_question: Does a source-faithful M5 gold impulse-exhaustion pattern—unusually large full-bodied impulse followed immediately by an opposite candle closing through the impulse body—create executable 30-second reversal persistence under frozen P75 execution?
source_basis: Open-source TradingView 5 Min Gold Reversal Signals: unusually strong candle based on recent range and minimum body percentage, followed by an opposite candle that closes beyond the previous candle's body.

The publication exposes adjustable impulse lookback/range multiplier/body percentage but not the exact defaults; this checkpoint therefore preregisters a transparent faithful reconstruction rather than claiming exact reproduction.
reconstruction_disclosure: Source defaults are incomplete. Freeze 20-bar range lookback, 1.5x average-range impulse threshold and 70% minimum body before compute; no post-result tuning.

frozen_signal.bearish_reversal: prior bar bullish impulse; current bar bearish and closes below prior bar open
frozen_signal.bullish_reversal: prior bar bearish impulse; current bar bullish and closes above prior bar open
frozen_signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after confirmation bar right edge

failure_rule: If the single preregistered faithful reconstruction fails supply/day or direct-net gate, retire IER rather than tune it on Stage-A.
advance_rule: If it passes, freeze unchanged for independent later-January validation.
